headline: Quiet Sunday as earlier news fades
body: No new events were scored on this Sunday. Every ending moved by less than 0.1 point as the effect of earlier announcements, such as the week's data-center protests and Xi's cooperation body, faded a little further, by up to 0.05. Horizon Balance eased to 1.91, and the world factors were unchanged.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Protector God -0.05 and Enslaved God -0.05.
